profile.headline: Web Developer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Developer with a demonstrated work history across multiple facets of the technology industry. Skilled in Ruby on Rails, iOS application development, infrastructure management, as well as mobile and desktop deployments. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor’s Degree focused in Computer Science from The University of Alabama.

positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
• Worked with clients to create modern, responsive websites and applications.
• Provided support to clients which includes instruction, maintenance, and website improvements.
• Implemented systems to improve application responsiveness and security.
• Worked with the development team to create multiple iOS applications with corresponding back-end components.
• Assisted in development, deployment, and support of a vendor credentialing system used in multiple states.

positions.title: Systems Assistant
positions.description:
•  Provided extensive support across the entire Apple ecosystem
•  Managed large computer labs using industry standard technologies
•  Identified hardware and software needs to provide solutions to technical problems
•  Supported the College of Arts and Science's academic continuity effort
•  Assisted with development and deployment of packages and scripts
•  Maintained and supported various Mac and Windows based servers

honors.title: UA Student Employee of the Year Nominee
honors.issuer: Issued by College of Arts & Sciences · Apr 2014
